title: Facial-Cue Removal in Sport: R1 analysis code and controlled-access stimulus archive
description: Preparation package for Frontiers in Human Neuroscience manuscript 1960815: R1 analysis code, aggregate results and 24 image files forming 12 Standard/Faceless scene pairs. All images are 1056 by 1056 pixels. Twelve JPEG files match the historical B-task project assets exactly; twelve PNG files were newly supplied by the author on 2026-11-07. The image count matches the manuscript; historical presentation order and linkage of the additional PNG files to acquisition records have not been independently verified. Files require controlled access with corresponding-author approval. Photograph source and rights documents have not been supplied; images are excluded from the MIT software license. Raw participant observations are not included. Original Quest processing reproduction remains incomplete. This preparation metadata does not assert a published record or DOI.
access_conditions: Contact corresponding author Seongdae Kim (kimsd@hongik.ac.kr), or Seungbeom Kim (sbkim@hongik.ac.kr), with name, institution and intended research use. Access is granted only after corresponding-author approval and subject to applicable photograph rights. No onward redistribution permission is implied.
